item: CI builds the project's wheel in the lockfile-install job and checks its own file list against the tracked tree, so a data file the wheel lacks is found at PR time and not after the tag (R380)
summary: Only release.yml built the wheel, at tag time, and every CI job installs editable (which reads the checkout), so a data file the code reads and the wheel lacks could not show up in CI. lockfile-install now ends with a step that builds the wheel the way the tag build does (python -m build, sdist first, so MANIFEST.in decides) and runs scripts/check_wheel_layout.py on it: every tracked file under src/, configs/, migrations/, docs/legal/ and docs/i18n/ must be in the wheel unless NOT_SHIPPED names it with a reason (one today, src/analytics/duckdb_ext/README.md), plus twelve anchors read against the wheel alone, and the checker prints the wheel's Generator line. MEASURED on 8850e61ca: python -m build 20.1 s (pip wheel 14.0 s), 18,197,068 B, 1,132 files / 1,138 zip entries (src 826, configs 147, migrations 81, docs 78); nothing else under the five trees is missing; 2,350 tracked docs files in the developer trees are not shipped, on purpose. tests/test_wheel_layout_check.py pins the checker on synthetic file lists (every anchor dropped in turn, a whole tree, file kinds no glob lists, a stale exemption, the lists pinned exactly, tracked_files on a real git repo) and tests/test_ci_wheel_layout_step.py names twenty-six mutants of the workflow. R379 sweep riding this PR: the #1609 lesson and shipped row now carry the measured figures (run 40638055096) instead of the inferred ones. STATED LIMITS: it reads a file list, it does not install the wheel or boot the app from it; docs are asked for only through the two subtrees and the manual; it does not catch R330 itself: sources.yml is in the wheel, the bug was the path built in the route, so OSM's route test stays the other half; the build resolves setuptools unpinned like the tag build (R381), so a setuptools release that breaks the build reddens this step first; setuptools already announces that project.license as a TOML table stops building after 2027-Feb-18, which affects the tag build and this step alike.
